propositions: CodeQL's weekly cron (23 4 * * 1) became the primary scan of newly-landed code after push-to-main was removed, leaving SAST findings unscanned for up to 7 days.
The 6-hourly tick was specified as the replacement for push-on-main; CodeQL should join it to restore intended coverage of new code changes.
CodeQL must be scheduled at 35 */6 * * * with other 6-hourly lanes staggered on distinct off-the-hour minutes (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53).
Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py must be retargeted to assert CodeQL's new 6-hourly cadence while retaining its no-push and workflow_dispatch invariants.
The stale header comment in codeql.yml citing 28x cost increase must be removed; the cost rationale does not apply to public repositories where GitHub Actions minutes are free.
